verdict.rationale: Feitian's docs show the lineup covers both USB-A and USB-C (BioPass K26 lists a Type-A/Type-C port) and adds options like a Lightning + USB-C dual key and USB + NFC keys. Nothing in the evidence documents keychain or low-profile nano form factors, so only the port half of the story is supported. missing for 10: evidence of keychain form-factor models, evidence of low-profile nano models, independent or hands-on corroboration of the model lineup.

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors

citations.quote: The built-in USB Type-A Type-C port (model K26) makes BioPass FIDO2 Security Key the perfect match for your cutting-edge computers.
MFi & FIDO2 certified Security Key, with built-in Apple Lightning & USB-C dual interface.
USB + NFC security key for login on PC and Android
